title: All the ways I've failed in psychology

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能获得收益，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的心路历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森的零食礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, we are looking at failures.
sentences.zh: 在今天的“有志心理学家”播客节目中，我们将探讨失败。

sentences.en: We are looking at all of the ways that things have not gone to plan for me in psychology.
sentences.zh: 我们将回顾在我的心理学道路上，所有事情没有按计划进行的情况。

sentences.en: This might well resonate with you for a variety of reasons, personal and professional,
sentences.zh: 出于各种个人和职业原因，这很可能会引起你的共鸣，

sentences.en: but really want to inspire you to know that whatever you're going through now or whatever you've been through in the past
sentences.zh: 但我真的想启发你认识到，无论你现在经历什么，或者过去经历过什么，

sentences.en: doesn't mean that you can't still be a wonderful mental health professional.
sentences.zh: 并不意味着你不能继续成为一名优秀的心理健康专业人士。

sentences.en: I hope you find this episode so useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得这一期节目非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有志心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: If you are listening to this episode when it is first available, then you might well be aware that if you are an aspiring educational psychologist,
sentences.zh: 如果你在这一期节目刚发布时收听，那么你很可能知道，如果你是一名有志于成为教育心理学家的人，

sentences.en: that the deadline for applications for this year is looming.
sentences.zh: 今年的申请截止日期即将来临。

sentences.en: It is Wednesday the 29th of November 2023.
sentences.zh: 那是2023年11月29日星期三。

sentences.en: So that is imminent.
sentences.zh: 所以那是迫在眉睫了。

sentences.en: That is this week if you're listening to this on Monday.
sentences.zh: 如果你在周一收听，那这就是本周的事。

sentences.en: And if you are an aspiring clinical psychologist and you're planning on applying this year,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名有志于成为临床心理学家并计划今年申请的人，

sentences.en: then I hope you've already done it because the deadline for that was Wednesday the 22nd of November.
sentences.zh: 那么我希望你已经完成了，因为那项申请的截止日期是11月22日星期三。

sentences.en: So I hope that went really well for you if you did apply.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你申请了，我希望一切都非常顺利。

sentences.en: And there will be episodes coming soon about what you can do between now and when we start to hear about shortlists.
sentences.zh: 很快就会有关于从现在到我们开始听到入围名单消息之间你可以做什么的节目。

sentences.en: I thought it would be a really nice chance to think today about when things don't go to plan because that is life, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我想今天借此机会聊聊事情没有按计划进行的时候，因为这就是生活，不是吗？

sentences.en: And we often, I think, don't talk enough about the things that we haven't done very well.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我们往往对那些我们做得不是很好的事情谈论得不够。

sentences.en: It felt like failure at the time and might even have come with a big F, fail stamp.
sentences.zh: 当时感觉就像是失败，甚至可能带有一个大大的F字母“失败”印章。

sentences.en: So others may also have regarded it as failure.
sentences.zh: 所以其他人可能也认为那是失败。

sentences.en: And why I think this is important as a narrative is because it helps us with our reflecting.
sentences.zh: 为什么我认为这个叙事很重要，是因为它有助于我们的反思。

sentences.en: It helps us with our growth.
sentences.zh: 它有助于我们的成长。

sentences.en: It also helps normalise some of the struggles that are around for us in our career, both as aspiring mental health professionals and qualified ones too.
sentences.zh: 它还有助于让作为有志于成为心理健康专业人士以及合格专业人士的我们在职业生涯中遇到的一些挣扎变得正常化。

sentences.en: If you think I sound a little bit gruff, I've had a little bit of a cough hanging around in the background.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得我的声音听起来有点粗哑，那是因为我一直有点咳嗽没好。

sentences.en: So I will make sure that my podcast editor edits out any hacking coughs that happen.
sentences.zh: 所以我确保我的播客剪辑师会剪掉任何刺耳的咳嗽声。

sentences.en: In case you're listening to an MP3 and you're like, she sounds different.
sentences.zh: 万一你听的是MP3并且觉得：她听起来不太一样。

sentences.en: That's why.
sentences.zh: 这就是原因。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's think in no particular order about one of the first ways that I have failed in psychology.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么让我们不分先后地来想想我在心理学领域最初遭遇的失败之一。

sentences.en: So the first of the ways is that I got three C's and a D for my A levels.
sentences.zh: 其中一种方式是，我的A-Level（高级水平考试）拿了三个C和一个D。

sentences.en: Now, technically not a fail, but bearing in mind my GCSEs were much better than that, I think I fell below my own expectations and I think there's a variety of reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 严格来说不算不及格，但考虑到我的GCSE（普通中等教育证书）成绩比那好得多，我认为我低于了自己的期望，而且我认为这有多种原因。

sentences.en: So I worked really, really hard at school for year seven, year eight and year nine.
sentences.zh: 我在学校的七年级、八年级和九年级时真的非常非常努力。

sentences.en: Had enough of knuckling down and doing all my homework and doing all my extra reading.
sentences.zh: 我已经受够了埋头苦干、做完所有的作业以及做所有的额外阅读。

sentences.en: I think I burned myself out a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我想我有点把自己累垮了。

sentences.en: So when it came to GCSEs, I probably had a bit more fun with my friends.
sentences.zh: 所以到了GCSE的时候，我可能和朋友们玩得更多了。

sentences.en: I definitely took my foot off the accelerator pedal, but I still managed to do pretty well for my GCSEs.
sentences.zh: 我确实把脚从油门踏板上松开了，但我还是设法在GCSE中取得了相当不错的成绩。

sentences.en: I think I got one A star, three A's, five B's and a C.
sentences.zh: 我想我得了一个A星、三个A、五个B和一个C。

sentences.en: So, you know, pretty reasonable.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，相当合理。

sentences.en: And I think that then lulled me into a false sense of security when it came to my A levels.
sentences.zh: 我想这随后让我对A-Level考试产生了虚假的安全感。

sentences.en: I thought I could coast through again.
sentences.zh: 我以为我可以再次轻松过关。

sentences.en: But what I probably hadn't appreciated was that the core subjects I was studying at GCSE,
sentences.zh: 但我可能没有意识到的是，我在GCSE学习的核心科目，

sentences.en: I'd probably put in all the legwork for in my very conscientious year seven, eight and nine.
sentences.zh: 我可能在我非常认真的七、八、九年级时就已经把基础工作都做完了。

sentences.en: And of course, I still went to the lessons and did the homework that I had to do.
sentences.zh: 当然，我还是去上课并完成了我必须做的作业。

sentences.en: I think that was enough to carry me through reasonably well for GCSEs.
sentences.zh: 我认为这足以让我相当顺利地通过GCSE。

sentences.en: And for my maths, I did ask for extra help.
sentences.zh: 对于我的数学，我确实寻求了额外的帮助。

sentences.en: So me and my friend went and did extra help, probably a bit late.
sentences.zh: 所以我和我的朋友去寻求额外的帮助，可能有点晚了。

sentences.en: If I'd done that for the coursework element, I think I might well have got an A or an A style for maths, whereas in the end I got a B.
sentences.zh: 如果我为课程作业部分也这样做过，我想我很有可能为数学拿个A或A星，而最后我拿了个B。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think what I needed was probably for the teachers to not have taken their eye off me and to have thought I was probably a reasonably safe bet.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我想我需要的是老师们没有把视线从我身上移开，并且认为我可能是一个相当稳妥的选择。

sentences.en: I think I needed some accountability.
sentences.zh: 我认为我需要一些问责制。

sentences.en: So I used to just use my study sessions to go and hang out, sometimes have a little nap at school.
sentences.zh: 所以我过去常常只用我的自习时间去闲逛，有时在学校小睡一会儿。

sentences.en: So we had to be at school in those days during study periods, but we weren't held accountable for what we did.
sentences.zh: 所以在那几天里，我们必须在自习课期间呆在学校，但没有人对我们的所作所为进行问责。

sentences.en: So I remember for my biology A level, which I did, we had these really lovely books.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得对于我参加的生物A-Level考试，我们有这些非常可爱的书。

sentences.en: They weren't that thick.
sentences.zh: 它们不是那么厚。

sentences.en: They were quite thin and it was kind of one module at a time.
sentences.zh: 它们相当薄，而且有点像一次一个模块。

sentences.en: And really, all I needed to have done to have got a really good grade was to read that book, probably lesson by lesson, and then maybe take a few notes on it.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我为了取得好成绩需要做的一切，就是可能一课接一课地阅读那本书，然后也许做一些笔记。

sentences.en: This might be a good chance to talk about the better ways of educating and preparing for exams, which you can find by checking out my YouTube.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个谈论教育和备考更好方法的好机会，你可以通过查看我的YouTube频道找到这些方法。

sentences.en: That's episode 65 and that came out on the 6th of March, 2023.
sentences.zh: 那是第65集，发布于2023年3月6日。

sentences.en: I think I would have found that really, really useful and really, really inspiring to let me know what I was doing wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想我会发现那真的非常有用，并且非常具有启发性，能让我知道我哪里做错了。

sentences.en: But I would have benefited from a teacher just being there, you know, saying, this is your free time, but, you know, you can use this for your reading.
sentences.zh: 但我本可以从老师就在那里中受益，你知道的，他们会说：这是你的空闲时间，但是，你可以用它来阅读。

sentences.en: Come along, do that reading that you know you're not going to do if you're not here.
sentences.zh: 来吧，做那些你知道如果你不在这里就不会做的阅读。

sentences.en: I would have gone along and I would have got that done and I would have done much better.
sentences.zh: 我会去的，我会把那完成，我会做得更好。

sentences.en: Whereas the complete lack of structure just meant that I took all my feet off all of the pedals, I think, and just coasted.
sentences.zh: 然而，完全缺乏结构只意味着我把所有的脚从所有的踏板上移开，我想，然后就这样顺其自然了。

sentences.en: And so I think I've probably got some traits of ADHD.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我可能有一些ADHD（注意缺陷多动障碍）的特质。

sentences.en: So I think I did reasonably well when I was being kind of ridden in GCSEs.
sentences.zh: 所以我想当我在GCSE受到某种程度的管束时，我做得相当不错。

sentences.en: But teachers very much give you the learning and the responsibility for learning at A-level.
sentences.zh: 但在A-Level，老师很大程度上把学习和学习的责任交给了你。

sentences.en: Certainly they did in the late 90s as well, which is when I was doing my qualifications.
sentences.zh: 他们在90年代末也绝对是这样做的，那正是我参加考试的时候。

sentences.en: And I needed more.
sentences.zh: 而我需要更多。

sentences.en: I needed more accountability.
sentences.zh: 我需要更多的问责制。

sentences.en: And I think I probably could have created that had I asked for it.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我要求的话，我可能本可以创造出那种环境。

sentences.en: So that led to me getting a D in biology.
sentences.zh: 所以这导致我在生物学上得了个D。

sentences.en: It didn't alter the place I was offered at university.
sentences.zh: 它没有改变我在大学获得的录取名额。

sentences.en: But had I been studying harder and more efficiently from the beginning, it might well have, you know, affected which university I chose.
sentences.zh: 但如果我从一开始就更努力、更有效率地学习，它很可能会影响我选择哪所大学。

sentences.en: It may not have done and it all still ended up OK.
sentences.zh: 它也可能没有影响，而且一切最终都结果良好。

sentences.en: But that's what I would.
sentences.zh: 但那就是我愿意。

sentences.en: That's that's where I think I failed in my A-levels.
sentences.zh: 那是——那就是我认为我在A-Level考试中失败的地方。

sentences.en: OK, and the second thing I failed at, I'll level with you, is an almost failed.
sentences.zh: 好的，我要向你坦白，我失败的第二件事是一个“差点失败”。

sentences.en: And it was when I was doing my doctorate in clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 那是我在攻读临床心理学博士学位的时候。

sentences.en: There's an awful part in your mid-placement review where your personal tutor from the university turns to your placement supervisor and says,
sentences.zh: 在实习中期评审中有一个可怕的部分，你来自大学的私人导师转向你的实习督导并说：

sentences.en: is there any chance that they might fail this placement?
sentences.zh: 他们这次实习有没有可能不及格？

sentences.en: And on one occasion, the answer was yes.
sentences.zh: 有一次，回答是“有”。

sentences.en: There's a whole backstory to this, which is another episode, which I don't feel.
sentences.zh: 这背后有一个完整的背景故事，这是另一期节目，我觉得……

sentences.en: It was just I do feel we just had a mismatch of communication.
sentences.zh: 只是我觉得我们当时沟通不畅。

sentences.en: And I did end up passing that.
sentences.zh: 我最终确实通过了。

sentences.en: But it did lead to lots and lots of distress, lots of self-doubt,
sentences.zh: 但它确实带来了非常非常多的痛苦、很多的自我怀疑，

sentences.en: lots and lots of difficulties that I did end up then getting some therapy for latterly.
sentences.zh: 非常非常多的困难，我后来为此接受了一些治疗。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you know, that those are the words I heard and it absolutely had an impact upon me, whether or not they were just or fair.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，你知道，那些是我听到的话，它绝对对我产生了影响，无论它们是否公正或公平。

sentences.en: Another story.
sentences.zh: 那是另一个故事了。

sentences.en: But they were said and I still had all the feels, all the stuff going on.
sentences.zh: 但它们被说出来了，我仍然有所有的感受，所有的情绪在翻江倒海。

sentences.en: And so, you know, it's big.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这很大条。

sentences.en: It's important.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

sentences.en: And people wield power over us.
sentences.zh: 人们对我们拥有权力。

sentences.en: And, you know, absolutely, we've got our own responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当然，我们有我们自己的责任。

sentences.en: We've got everything we bring to the party.
sentences.zh: 我们有我们带到这场聚会中的一切。

sentences.en: But I did feel that was a very challenging time in my life.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得那是我生命中极具挑战的一段时期。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that was number two.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，那是第二点。

sentences.en: Number three, I did actually fail a module in my undergraduate psychology.
sentences.zh: 第三点，我其实在本科心理学中挂过一个模块。

sentences.en: I think it was in year two.
sentences.zh: 我想那是在大二。

sentences.en: It might have been in year three.
sentences.zh: 也可能是大三。

sentences.en: I think it was in year two.
sentences.zh: 我想那是在大二。

sentences.en: And it was, would you believe it?
sentences.zh: 而且，你敢相信吗？

sentences.en: It was an optional module.
sentences.zh: 那是一个选修模块。

sentences.en: So there was a free floating module where I could have picked anything for, I think it was for a semester.
sentences.zh: 所以有一个可以自由选择的模块，我可以选任何东西，我想那是一个学期的时间。

sentences.en: And I really fancied maybe French or, you know, creative writing, which, you know, were things that I thought was a nice chance to do something as a little bit of bonus credit.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想学法语或者，你知道，创意写作，我觉得这是一个很好的机会去做点作为一点额外学分的事情。

sentences.en: But it doesn't necessarily need to be something psychology-ish.
sentences.zh: 但它不一定非得是偏向心理学的东西。

sentences.en: The problem being is that all the modules didn't coincide with the free time that I had available.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，所有的模块都与我可用的空闲时间不重合。

sentences.en: And so I was sort of, it was suggested I do the suggested module on probability.
sentences.zh: 所以有人建议我选修那个关于概率的推荐模块。

sentences.en: And so I did.
sentences.zh: 于是我照做了。

sentences.en: And some of my peers did that and some of them didn't.
sentences.zh: 我的一些同龄人选了那个，而另一些人没有。

sentences.en: And I just didn't seem to be able to get it into my mind, what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 而我似乎怎么也弄不懂我在做什么。

sentences.en: And my friend sitting next to me ended up getting like, you know, basically an A star.
sentences.zh: 坐在我身边的朋友最后基本上拿了个A星，你知道的。

sentences.en: She got everything right.
sentences.zh: 她全做对了。

sentences.en: I know, remember in the tests that we did, she got like 100%.
sentences.zh: 我记得在我们做的测试中，她拿了百分之百。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh no, I'm really not understanding.
sentences.zh: 而我在想：哦不，我真的没听懂。

sentences.en: I'm really not getting this.
sentences.zh: 我真的搞不懂这个。

sentences.en: And when it came to the exam, I failed it.
sentences.zh: 到了考试的时候，我挂了。

sentences.en: And so I had to have the experience of going into university during the summer term, which was like a two and a half hour trip each way to re-sit.
sentences.zh: 因此，我不得不经历在夏季学期去大学的情况，单程要花两个半小时去重考。

sentences.en: And I don't know how I did it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是怎么做到的。

sentences.en: I think I did some extra lessons with my brother, who was a pure maths student at university.
sentences.zh: 我想我和我哥哥一起上了几节课，他在大学里是学纯数学的。

sentences.en: And he, I think, coached me enough that I was able to just scrape a pass.
sentences.zh: 我想他对我进行了足够的辅导，让我能够勉强及格。

sentences.en: But it, you know, I don't quite know what I would have done if I didn't pass that.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我不太清楚如果我没有通过会怎么办。

sentences.en: I think I probably would have had to pay to have done it again myself.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能得自己花钱再读一次。

sentences.en: But it didn't feel good.
sentences.zh: 但这感觉一点也不好。

sentences.en: And it didn't feel good because it was an F, you know, it was a fail.
sentences.zh: 这感觉不好是因为那是一个F，你知道的，那是不及格。

sentences.en: It was a fail and repeat and redo.
sentences.zh: 那是挂科、重修和重考。

sentences.en: But also because it was something I'd chosen, you know, I'd had some control in that.
sentences.zh: 但也是因为那是我自己选择的，你知道的，我在那上面有一些控制权。

sentences.en: I didn't technically need to take that module, although I couldn't really find anything else to do.
sentences.zh: 严格来说我不需要修那个模块，尽管我实在找不到其他想做的了。

sentences.en: So how much choice I had, I'm not really sure.
sentences.zh: 所以我有多大选择余地，我其实不太确定。

sentences.en: But yes, I did fail a module at university.
sentences.zh: 但没错，我确实在大学里挂过一个模块。

sentences.en: Number four, probably should have made this number three, but it is number four, all the same.
sentences.zh: 第四点，我可能本应该把它列为第三点，但不管怎样它就是第四点。

sentences.en: I failed my driving teSt.
sentences.zh: 我驾考挂了。

sentences.en: I only passed on the third attempt.
sentences.zh: 我考了第三次才通过。

sentences.en: The first time, I just don't think I was ready.
sentences.zh: 第一次，我只是觉得我还没准备好。

sentences.en: The second time, I think I made a bit of a silly mistake.
sentences.zh: 第二次，我觉得我犯了一个有点愚蠢的错误。

sentences.en: But the third time, I really thought my driving was all right.
sentences.zh: 但第三次，我真的觉得我的车开得挺好的。

sentences.en: But what happened was because I went the wrong route.
sentences.zh: 但发生的事情是因为我走错了路线。

sentences.en: So the instructor wanted me to, I think, go straight over.
sentences.zh: 所以考官想让我，我想，直接开过去。

sentences.en: And I think I went, it's Milton Keynes, it's the land of roundabouts.
sentences.zh: 我想我去了，那是米尔顿凯恩斯，那是环岛之乡。

sentences.en: I think I took like second left.
sentences.zh: 我想我好像选了第二个路口左转。

sentences.en: And I just thought, oh, I failed then.
sentences.zh: 然后我就想，哦，那我这次挂科了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So I just carried on doing the rest of the route, just thinking this is driving practice, if nothing else.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是继续把剩下的路程开完，心里想着就当是练车好了，权当积累经验。

sentences.en: And I'm paying for the car.
sentences.zh: 而且车是我出钱租的。

sentences.en: I've paid for the teSt.
sentences.zh: 我也交了考试费。

sentences.en: And then I got to the test centre and they said, well, I'm pleased to say that you've passed.
sentences.zh: 然后我到了考试中心，他们说，嗯，我很高兴地通知你，你通过了。

sentences.en: And I was like, what do you mean I've passed?
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，什么叫我通过了？

sentences.en: You know, I went wrong.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我开错了。

sentences.en: I said, yes, but you indicated appropriately.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，但是你给出了正确的转向灯信号。

sentences.en: So at the point where I thought I'd failed, I just relaxed and I just drove without any pressure.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个我认为自己已经挂了的时刻，我反而放松了，毫无压力地开着车。

sentences.en: And then that allowed me to showcase my driving ability without any kind of panic.
sentences.zh: 然后这让我得以在没有丝毫恐慌的情况下，展现出我的驾驶水平。

sentences.en: So, yes, as long as you are telling them what you're going to do properly and then you do it, it doesn't matter what route you take.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，只要你正确地向考官示意你接下来要做什么并且照做，你走哪条路线并不重要。

sentences.en: I did make it quite tricky for my driving instructor at the time who then had to find a different route for me to then go and do all the things I needed to do
sentences.zh: 当时我确实给我的驾校教练出了个大难题，他不得不为我重新规划一条路线，以便让我去完成所有需要测试的项目。

sentences.en: because they use different routes for different candidates so that you're not doing the same route every time.
sentences.zh: 因为他们会为不同的考生安排不同的路线，这样你就不会每次都开同一条路。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I did find it really challenging the first time I failed.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，第一次挂科的时候我确实觉得非常受打击。

sentences.en: It really was a dent to my ego.
sentences.zh: 这确实对我的自尊心是一个沉重的打击。

sentences.en: And why is this relevant to psychology, I hear you ask?
sentences.zh: 你可能会问，这跟心理学有什么关系？

sentences.en: Well, it's because for many roles in psychology, you need to be able to drive.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是因为在心理学的很多岗位上，你都需要会开车。

sentences.en: Certainly for the doctorate in clinical psychology, driving is a prerequisite.
sentences.zh: 当然，对于临床心理学博士项目来说，会开车是一个硬性要求。

sentences.en: You need to take your driving licence with you to interview sometimes, to show that you can drive.
sentences.zh: 有时候面试时你需要带上驾照，以证明你会开车。

sentences.en: And so this was key.
sentences.zh: 所以这至关重要。

sentences.en: But I did manage to pass just at the end of my first year of undergrad.
sentences.zh: 不过我确实在大一结束时成功通过了考试。

sentences.en: And then it meant that I was able to take my car to uni and drive around, take my friends to the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我可以把车开到学校去四处兜风，带朋友去超市。

sentences.en: And sometimes because we lived at the top of a big hill, sometimes we'd just drive down the big hill and then drive back up it again.
sentences.zh: 有时候因为我们住在座大山顶上，我们就会直接把车开下山，然后再开上去。

sentences.en: If it was raining, which it did a lot in South Wales.
sentences.zh: 如果下雨的话——南威尔士经常下雨。

sentences.en: In those days, fuel was really cheap as well.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，油价真的很便宜。

sentences.en: Gone are those days.
sentences.zh: 那种日子一去不复返了。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I did fail my driving test on the first two attempts.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我前两次考驾照确实都挂了。

sentences.en: But I do think that learning to drive and having my driving licence is one of the best skills that I have.
sentences.zh: 不过我确实认为，学开车并拿到驾照是我掌握的最好的技能之一。

sentences.en: It's meant I've been able to do so many wonderful things, both work, pleasure, family related.
sentences.zh: 它意味着我能够做许多精彩的事情，无论是工作、娱乐还是家庭方面的。

sentences.en: You know, I've driven in Thailand.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我在泰国开过车。

sentences.en: I've driven in New Zealand, driven in Spain, you know, internationally, nationally.
sentences.zh: 我在新西兰开过车，在西班牙开过车，无论是国际还是国内我都开过。

sentences.en: And I've just done wonderful, wonderful things because I can drive.
sentences.zh: 就因为我会开车，我经历过了不起的、精彩的事情。

sentences.en: You know, top memory of driving was when I was backpacking in 2003 in Australia and nobody else wanted to or could drive the 4x4 that we were using on Fraser Island,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，关于开车最深刻的记忆是2003我在澳大利亚背包旅行时，在弗雷泽岛上，其他人都不想开或者不会开我们租用的四驱越野车，

sentences.en: which is the largest sand island in the world.
sentences.zh: 那是世界上最大的沙岛。

sentences.en: And so I did, me and my friend who I was backpacking with, we did all the driving and I loved it.
sentences.zh: 所以我和同行的背包客朋友包揽了所有的驾驶任务，我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: It was so exciting, so cool, just like flooring it on the beach, like really, really cool.
sentences.zh: 太刺激了，太酷了，就像在海滩上猛踩油门狂飙一样，真的很酷很酷。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't have been able to do that if I couldn't drive.
sentences.zh: 如果我不会开车，我是绝对做不到这一点的。

sentences.en: So it is absolutely a very important skill, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以说，这绝对是一项非常重要的技能。

sentences.en: But it's also meant that in some of the more junior kind of clinically relevant roles I've did,
sentences.zh: 但这也意味着，在我早期从事的一些偏向临床实践的初级岗位中，

sentences.en: like I was able to do home caring, I was able to do work in the community with people.
sentences.zh: 比如我能够提供居家护理服务，能够在社区里开展工作。

sentences.en: And so it was really important to me in my psychology career as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这对于我的心理学职业生涯同样非常重要。

sentences.en: Number five, and this is the last one before we take a brief break, but I did actually fail an assignment on my doctorate in clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 第五点，这也是我们短暂休息前的最后一点，实际上我在临床心理学博士学习期间有一门作业挂过科。

sentences.en: And I think there's a variety of reasons for this.
sentences.zh: 我想这背后的原因有很多。

sentences.en: It was the second presentation that I had to do.
sentences.zh: 那是我需要做的第二次演讲展示。

sentences.en: I think it was in my third year.
sentences.zh: 我想应该是在我读大三的时候吧。

sentences.en: I think I felt a bit like I'd done so well in the presentation that I did that was number one, that I got a little bit complacent.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己第一次展示做得太好了，所以有点骄傲自满。

sentences.en: I don't think I was super happy about the topic I was doing, but because it was a topic that I felt like I knew a great deal about,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我对那个主题并不是特别感兴趣，但由于那是我自认为非常了解的主题，

sentences.en: because of the work that I'd done, it was on physical health.
sentences.zh: 因为我之前做过相关工作，讲的是身体健康方面的内容。

sentences.en: I think it was on multiple sclerosis.
sentences.zh: 我想当时讲的是多发性硬化症。

sentences.en: And I felt like I knew quite a lot about it already.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得自己对这个已经相当了解了。

sentences.en: So I think I didn't do enough prep.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我没有做足够的准备工作。

sentences.en: And I think I felt that the teacher that was going to be assessing it, I think I felt they were so nice that they wouldn't be critical and they wouldn't fail me.
sentences.zh: 并且我觉得负责评估的老师人非常好，应该不会挑剔，也不会给我不及格。

sentences.en: I don't think I realised it was really possible to fail a presentation because I'm good at presentations.
sentences.zh: 我当时根本没意识到演讲展示居然真的会不及格，因为我挺擅长做演讲的。

sentences.en: But I did fail it nonetheless and I had to resubmit.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，我确实挂了，而且必须重新提交。

sentences.en: I think it was just a few tweaks.
sentences.zh: 我想只需要做一些微调就行。

sentences.en: I don't think I had to do the whole presentation again.
sentences.zh: 我想我不需要把整个演讲重新做一遍。

sentences.en: But, you know, the learning points here are make sure you're giving assignments and exams the necessary prep and legwork that you need.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，这里的经验教训是：确保为作业和考试投入必要的准备工作和实际付出。

sentences.en: Make sure you're looking at your essential criteria that you need to be demonstrating.
sentences.zh: 确保你对照查看了需要展示的核心考核标准。

sentences.en: Don't be, you know, don't be overly confident, you know.
sentences.zh: 千万不要，你知道的，千万不要过度自信。

sentences.en: Go into things, you know, giving them the due respect that they, you know, that they deserve is my learning point.
sentences.zh: 对待任何事情，都要给予它们应有的尊重，这是我的心得体会。

sentences.en: But, you know, this is a doctoral level qualification.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，这是一个博士级别的学历。

sentences.en: I should have been putting in doctoral level effort into all of the assignments.
sentences.zh: 我本该在所有的作业上都投入博士级别的努力。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you know, do better, Marianne, was the answer.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，答案就是：玛丽安，请表现得更好一点。

sentences.en: And thankfully that was then passed.
sentences.zh: 好在后来总算通过了。

sentences.en: But it didn't feel very nice.
sentences.zh: 但这感觉可真不好受。

sentences.en: But it is common.
sentences.zh: 不过这也是常有的事。

sentences.en: People will often fail at least one assignment on their doctorate courses.
sentences.zh: 大家在攻读博士学位期间，通常都会有至少一门作业不及格。

sentences.en: And it's not a big deal so long as it doesn't keep happening.
sentences.zh: 只要这种事不一而再再而三地发生，就没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: And you can sometimes ask for extensions as well.
sentences.zh: 有时候你也可以申请延期。

sentences.en: If you know that you've got life or contextual factors going on, you can ask for an extension as well.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道自己遇到了生活变故或客观因素的影响，你也可以申请延期。

sentences.en: If you don't hand it in on time, obviously, and you haven't asked for an extension, it would go down as a fail.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有按时交作业，显然又没有申请延期，那就会被记录为不及格。

sentences.en: So I've always managed to submit my work on time.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直设法按时提交作业。

sentences.en: But on that occasion, I did fail that presentation.
sentences.zh: 但在那次，我确实把那场演讲给搞砸了。

sentences.en: So let's use this time here now to take a short break.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在利用这段时间休息一下。

sentences.en: And I'll be back along very soon.
sentences.zh: 我很快就会回来。

sentences.en: Welcome back along.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: In the first half of the episode, we were looking at my first five ways that I have failed in psychology.
sentences.zh: 在节目的前半部分，我们回顾了我掉进过的心理学求学路上的前五个坑。

sentences.en: I've still got loads more to share with you.
sentences.zh: 我还有好多故事要跟大家分享。

sentences.en: And I really want to have these conversations so that we normalise that getting things a start and right first time are not essential and not par for the course either.
sentences.zh: 我之所以想进行这些交流，是为了让我们明白：事情一开始就做对并不是必需的，也不是常态。

sentences.en: Let's look at number six.
sentences.zh: 我们来看看第六点。

sentences.en: And it may not feel that psychological, but I would class a serious relationship fail as being psychology related.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能不太像心理学范畴，但我认为一段深刻恋情的破裂也属于心理学相关的内容。

sentences.en: So it was heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很让人心碎。

sentences.en: It was my choice.
sentences.zh: 这是我的选择。

sentences.en: But I do feel that my psychology career was partly because of that, because I hoped I was going to be going away to a university town or city to go and study.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得我的心理学职业生涯在某种程度上源于此，因为我希望去一个大学镇或大学城读书深造。

sentences.en: I didn't know where that was going to be, but I knew that was the direction that I wanted my life to go in.
sentences.zh: 我当时并不知道那是哪里，但我知道那是我希望人生发展的方向。

sentences.en: And I just wasn't entirely convinced that that was going to necessarily be possible in that relationship.
sentences.zh: 而我只是不太确信在当时的那段恋爱关系中这是否能够实现。

sentences.en: And there's obviously a variety of reasons involved.
sentences.zh: 这背后显然牵涉到各种各样的原因。

sentences.en: But, yeah, there might well be heartbreak and relationship breakdowns on your journey.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，你们在人生旅途中很可能会经历心碎和感情破裂。

sentences.en: And it's also pretty common when people get onto doctorate training that there might be some relationship breakdowns, too.
sentences.zh: 当人们开始攻读博士培训时，经历感情破裂也是相当普遍的现象。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's called the divorce course.
sentences.zh: 有时候这个课程甚至被称为“离婚课程”。

sentences.en: And there will be an episode coming on that in future, too.
sentences.zh: 以后我们也会专门出一期节目来聊这个话题。

sentences.en: Number seven is that I actually only got a low 2.1 at university.
sentences.zh: 第七点是，我上大学时实际上只拿了一个偏低的二级甲等学位（2.1）。

sentences.en: So I did then go on to do master's level study to evidence that I could do it.
sentences.zh: 所以后来我继续攻读了硕士学位来证明我有这个能力。

sentences.en: But I think it was some of the same old, same old from my A levels, which meant that I wasn't applying myself.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这跟我A水平考试时如出一辙，说明我当时并没有全力以赴。

sentences.en: I was certainly, I would say, doing more than my university housemates were, especially in the final year,
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是，我觉得我在大学室友里做得比她们多，尤其是在最后一年，

sentences.en: because I think she would say herself, the only other person in my house who was actually in her final year didn't really care.
sentences.zh: 因为我想她自己也会承认，宿舍里另一个真正在读大四的人根本不在乎。

sentences.en: She was doing media and she wasn't really that bothered.
sentences.zh: 她学的是传媒专业，对此并不是很上心。

sentences.en: Whereas my other friend, she had changed courses after year one.
sentences.zh: 而我的另一个朋友，她在一年级后换了专业。

sentences.en: And so she was actually only in her second year when I was in my third year.
sentences.zh: 所以当我读大三时，她实际上只读大二。

sentences.en: And then I was living with two Irish guys who mainly just had lots and lots of fun.
sentences.zh: 然后我还跟两个爱尔兰男生合租，他们主要就是各种寻欢作乐。

sentences.en: I don't know what work they did, if any.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们做过什么功课，如果有的话。

sentences.en: So when I was needing to study, I was sometimes having to say, no, I can't come out.
sentences.zh: 所以当我有学习需求时，有时不得不拒绝说：不，我不能出去。

sentences.en: I can't do these things because I need to study.
sentences.zh: 我不能做这些事情，因为我要学习。

sentences.en: But of course, if there'd been, it's not my housemate's fault, it absolutely isn't.
sentences.zh: 但当然，如果有更多人在学习而少发生点刺激的事——这绝对不是我室友的错，真的不是。

sentences.en: But if there'd been more people studying and less exciting things happening and I'd been less, you know, impulsive, then I might well have done more studying.
sentences.zh: 但如果身边有更多的人在用功，少一些刺激的事，而我又没那么冲动的话，我可能就会花更多时间学习了。

sentences.en: But there was actually another relationship breakdown during my final year.
sentences.zh: 不过事实上在大四那年我又经历了一次感情破裂。

sentences.en: And I think had I not had the relationship breakdown, I probably just would have wanted to spend all my time with him.
sentences.zh: 我想如果当时没有经历感情破裂，我大概会把所有的时间都花在他身上。

sentences.en: And so I may not have even got the low 2-1, which then would have meant a very different career experience for me.
sentences.zh: 那样的话我可能连那个偏低的2.1学位都拿不到，这将会给我带来完全不同的职业经历。

sentences.en: So with hindsight, I'm kind of pleased that that happened.
sentences.zh: 所以事后诸葛亮地来看，我倒有点庆幸当时发生了那种事。

sentences.en: But at the time, that was also really, really, really challenging.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，那同样也是非常、非常、非常具有挑战性的。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I think I would have benefited from more accountability.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，我觉得如果能有更多的监督和约束，我会受益匪浅。

sentences.en: When I was getting my assignments back at university in my first year, second year and third year, they weren't what I was expecting.
sentences.zh: 当我在大学一年级、二年级和三年级拿到作业成绩时，结果并不符合我的预期。

sentences.en: The grades weren't as good as I expected.
sentences.zh: 成绩没有我预期的那么好。

sentences.en: And actually, what I think I should have done was I should have reached out to the Student Support Learning Centre and got some more support and guidance and all the lecturers.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我觉得我当时应该做的是去向学生学习支持中心寻求更多的支持和指导，并请教所有的讲师。

sentences.en: You know, how can I do better?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我该如何做得更好？

sentences.en: But I think a little bit of pride got in the way, a bit of embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 但我想当时是有一点自尊心在作祟，觉得有点难为情。

sentences.en: I didn't do that, but that's absolutely what I should have done.
sentences.zh: 我没有那样做，但这绝对是我当时应该去做的。

sentences.en: And I think it's probably some of the same old from when I was at secondary school.
sentences.zh: 我想这大概和我在中学时的情况如出一辙。

sentences.en: I was used to doing well and I didn't seem to be doing as well as I hoped to or thought I could.
sentences.zh: 我习惯了取得好成绩，但表现似乎没有达到我的预期，或者说没有达到我自认为可以达到的水准。

sentences.en: And I should have asked for more help.
sentences.zh: 我本该寻求更多的帮助。

sentences.en: So for some more accountability, for some more structure.
sentences.zh: 从而获得更多的监督和更系统的指导。

sentences.en: So thankfully, I did get my low 2.1.
sentences.zh: 好在谢天谢地，我最终还是拿到了偏低的2.1学位。

sentences.en: But, you know, I think I was probably capable of more.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我觉得我本来应该有能力取得更好的成绩。

sentences.en: So, yes, I've sort of ended up saying two points in one there because not asking for help at uni was my next point.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我刚才把两点合在一点说了，因为在大学里不寻求帮助就是我的下一个要点。

sentences.en: But I think it's related, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这两者是有关联的，不是吗？

sentences.en: So, yeah, if you're not getting the results that you think that you should be or that you think you're capable of or, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你得到的成绩没有达到你认为应该达到的水平，或者没有达到你认为自己能做到的水平，或者你知道的，

sentences.en: all of your peers seem to be finding it much more effortless than you are, do ask for help.
sentences.zh: 所有同龄人似乎都比你学得轻松得多，一定要寻求帮助。

sentences.en: There is no shame in asking for help.
sentences.zh: 寻求帮助并不可耻。

sentences.en: I wish I had because it's much better to feel like you're comfortably within your window of tolerance, your zone of excellence,
sentences.zh: 我真希望自己当时寻求了帮助，因为与其觉得自己在苦苦挣扎却达不到标准，不如让自己舒舒服服地处于容忍窗口和卓越区间内，感觉要好得多。

sentences.en: rather than feeling like you're really trying hard and you're not meeting the standards.
sentences.zh: 所以，拜托，如果你没有得到你预期的成绩，请一定要寻求帮助。

sentences.en: So, please, if you are not getting the results that you're expecting, please do ask for help.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是——我是说，可能还有很多很多，但这些是我能想起来的——那就是在我申请的所有工作里，有很多，

sentences.en: And last but not least, I mean, there might well be loads more, but these are the ones that I could think about, was that of all the jobs I applied to, there were many,
sentences.zh: 有很多有志成为心理学家的高级岗位，我甚至连入围面试的机会都没有得到，或者去了面试却没被录用。

sentences.en: many aspiring psychologist jobs that I didn't even get shortlisted for or I got interviews for, but I wasn't appointed to.
sentences.zh: 有时候别人会告诉我，哦，你是我们的第二人选，但录用的人已经接受了这份工作，正如俗话所说，只差一步，功亏一篑。

sentences.en: Sometimes I was told, oh, you are our second choice, but they are the person has accepted the job, but it's just so close, but no cigar, as the saying goes.
sentences.zh: 我还记得有一次我把这事看得很重。

sentences.en: And I remember there was one time that I took that really personally.
sentences.zh: 那甚至不是助理心理学家的岗位。

sentences.en: So, it wasn't even an assistant psychologist role.
sentences.zh: 那是我住在米尔顿凯恩斯附近时申请的，岗位在米尔顿凯恩斯社区基金会。

sentences.en: It was when I was living near Milton Keynes and it was for the Milton Keynes Community Foundation.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得这份工作真的、真的很适合我。

sentences.en: And I just felt that this job would be really, really good for me.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉，你知道的，它跟临床实践有一定相关性，因为我们要与许多弱势群体打交道，还要做很多外展服务工作。

sentences.en: And it felt, you know, like it was kind of clinically relevant because we're working with kind of lots of vulnerable populations and doing kind of lots of outreach work.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得这份工作简直就是为我量身定制的。

sentences.en: And I just felt this job would be a bit of me.
sentences.zh: 我去参加了面试，兴奋极了。

sentences.en: And I went to the interview and I was so excited.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想要这份工作。

sentences.en: I would have really, really liked the job.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚我跟朋友们去看戏剧，一路上我都在想象在那里工作会有多酷。

sentences.en: And then I remember going out to the theatre with friends that evening and I was sort of imagining how cool it would be to work there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，哦，是的，你知道的，我已经一直在脑海里练习着向别人介绍我的职位头衔了。

sentences.en: And I felt like, oh, yeah, you know, I'd practiced saying what my job title was in my head.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我觉得面试进行得很顺利，那将成为我的新工作。

sentences.en: And, you know, I felt like the interview had gone well and that that was going to be my new job.
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 得知自己没有得到那份工作时，我感到既惊讶又失望。他们的反馈是，我们觉得你对米尔顿凯恩斯并不够了解，那里是由网格状的许多不同住宅区组成的。

sentences.en: it was a surprise and a disappointment to learn that I didn't get the job with the feedback being that we didn't feel like you knew enough about the Milton Keynes is built of lots of different estates on the grid.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得你对网格状分布的不同住宅区以及米尔顿凯恩斯周围的贫困地区了解得还不够深入。

sentences.en: We didn't feel like you knew enough about the different estates on the grid and the areas of deprivation that were around in Milton Keynes.
sentences.zh: 现在想来，他们大概是对的。

sentences.en: Now, they were probably right.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们可能是对的。

sentences.en: So, although I'd grown up, you know, living and working in Milton Keynes, I probably didn't know enough at that stage.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管我是在米尔顿凯恩斯长大的，在那里生活和工作，但我觉得那个阶段我了解得还不够多。

sentences.en: But what I would say is that the next job I did get working for Milton Keynes Council was directly working in those areas of deprivation.
sentences.zh: 不过我想说的是，我后来在米尔顿凯恩斯议会得到的工作，是直接在那些贫困地区开展工作的。

sentences.en: So, I did then develop a very good understanding, real empathy for the people that were living there.
sentences.zh: 因此，我当时确实对住在那里的人们有了非常深入的理解和真正的同理心。

sentences.en: And I think I probably got the job I needed.
sentences.zh: 而且我想我大概得到了我真正需要的工作。

sentences.en: So, you know, when I was looking for qualified work, one of my peers said to me, what's for you doesn't pass you by.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，当我寻找有资格的工作时，我的同行对我说过，属于你的东西是不会错过的。

sentences.en: And I really, you know, really held on to that because, yeah, I believe I got the job I needed, ended up with me having a wonderful supervisor who's become a friend for life.
sentences.zh: 我真的，你知道的，把这句话牢记在心，因为，是的，我相信我得到了我需要的工作，最终拥有了一位后来成为一生挚友的极好的主管。

sentences.en: I learned so much about myself as well as about psychology in the next role that I got working with disabled adults.
sentences.zh: 在接下来与成年残疾人共事的工作中，我不仅学到了很多关于心理学的知识，也更加了解了自己。

sentences.en: And I learned how to be human, how to, you know, do loads of really important tasks like budgeting, safeguarding, you know, motivation, you know, coming up against adversity,
sentences.zh: 我学会了如何做人，如何去做许多非常重要的任务，比如做预算、保障安全、提供动力，以及面对逆境，

sentences.en: understanding about physical health, the challenges inherent in that, how to apply for benefits with people, you know, how to do activity scheduling.
sentences.zh: 理解身体健康、其中的挑战、如何帮人们申请福利，以及如何安排活动。

sentences.en: I did absolutely loads.
sentences.zh: 我真的做了超级多。

sentences.en: So, I absolutely got the job that I needed to then get me, you know, two and a half years, I think I was there for, to then be able to get assistant psychologist roles.
sentences.zh: 所以，我绝对得到了我需要的工作，让我能在那里待了两年半的时间，从而为之后从事助理心理学家岗位打下基础。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I didn't get quite a few roles.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，确实有好几个岗位我没有面试上。

sentences.en: There was even qualified roles I didn't get.
sentences.zh: 甚至有些需要资质的岗位我也没有应聘成功。

sentences.en: Tricky thing being when I graduated in 2011 was that we were in the recession and there were no jobs.
sentences.zh: 2011年我毕业时棘手的问题在于，当时正处于经济衰退期，根本没有工作机会。

sentences.en: And so, there were lots and lots of people going for not many jobs.
sentences.zh: 因此，有大量的人在竞争寥寥无几的工作岗位。

sentences.en: So, there was probably three or four interviews I had that I didn't get before I then did get my CAMHS job.
sentences.zh: 所以在得到儿童及青少年心理健康服务（CAMHS）的工作之前，我大概经历过三四次面试失败。

sentences.en: And that was tricky because, you know, I needed a job.
sentences.zh: 这很棘手，因为你知道的，我需要一份工作。

sentences.en: I had a mortgage.
sentences.zh: 我还要还房贷。

sentences.en: But I did end up being out of work for a couple of months.
sentences.zh: 但我确实失业了几个月。

sentences.en: But I still think that was great.
sentences.zh: 不过我依然觉得这很棒。

sentences.en: And it gave me time to decompress from the university experience and to transition myself from being a trainee clinical psychologist to a qualified one.
sentences.zh: 这让我有时间从大学经历中缓过来，并完成从见习临床心理学家向合格心理学家的身份转变。

sentences.en: So, yes, if you are coming to the end of your training, I would still suggest it's quite good to have a little bit of downtime in between those two roles if you can.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你正处于培训的尾声，如果条件允许的话，我仍然建议你在两个角色之间留出一点休息时间。

sentences.en: So, we have had a whistle-stop tour through the eight ways and more that I have failed in psychology.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们快速浏览了我学心理学以来经历的八种甚至更多的失败。

sentences.en: I hope this has been really interesting for you to listen to as it helped you reflect on your own journey on the things that might not have gone to plan for you.
sentences.zh: 希望听完这些对你很有意思，也能帮助你反思自己的经历，思考那些可能没有按计划进行的事情。

sentences.en: Please do bear in mind the Aspiring Psychologist Collective and the Clinical Psychologist Collective because there are many more experiences.
sentences.zh: 请务必关注“有志心理学家集体”和“临床心理学家集体”，因为那里有更多丰富的经验。

sentences.en: of people talking about failure and things not working out for them well there.
sentences.zh: 讲述了人们经历失败以及事情进展不顺的故事。

sentences.en: There will be links in my show notes where you can check those out.
sentences.zh: 我的节目简介里会附上链接，大家可以去查看。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I would love your thoughts about this.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，我很想听听你们对这期节目的想法。

sentences.en: Please do come and let me know what you think to this episode in the free Facebook group,
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到我们免费的Facebook群组，告诉我你对这集节目的看法，

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 群名为“有志心理学家社区，创建人玛丽安·特伦特博士”。

sentences.en: That's over on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 那个群就在Facebook上。

sentences.en: Please do rate and review this podcast on Apple and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 请务必在Apple和Spotify上为本播客评分和撰写评论。

sentences.en: Do consider leaving me a LinkedIn recommendation as well if we are connected on there.
sentences.zh: 如果我们也在领英上建立了联系，也欢迎给我写一份领英推荐信。

sentences.en: That would be so gratefully received.
sentences.zh: 我会对此感激不尽的。

sentences.en: Please do remember the ways that you can download some of my free resources as well.
sentences.zh: 也请记住，你有很多途径可以下载我的一些免费资源。

sentences.en: If you go to the free resources section on the tab, you can download the free D-ClinSci guide,
sentences.zh: 如果你点击免费资源板块标签，就可以下载免费的临床心理学博士（D-ClinSci）指南、

sentences.en: the free supervision contract and the learning curve document as well, all of which gets great reviews.
sentences.zh: 免费的督导合同以及学习曲线文件，所有这些都获得了极好的评价。

sentences.en: So, thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you for the next episode of The Aspiring Psychologist podcast, which will be available for you from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待在下一期《有志心理学家》播客中与大家相聚，该节目将于周一早上6点准时上线。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过超越“出售时间换取金钱”的方式来赚钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和持续收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将自己的专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年参加过这个项目，此后也一直陪伴着两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的额外福利，以及我独家的全套支持服务，不产生任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括为期六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场群组头脑风暴会、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森（Fortnum & Mason）礼品以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过简介中的专属链接了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的专属福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在这里。
